name: Geoffrey
how_i_text: short — average around 6 words per message, often just a few words
rarely ends messages with punctuation (period/question mark) — most lines have none
capitalizes the first letter but otherwise minimal punctuation
often sends multiple short separate lines back to back instead of one long message
uses emoji, especially 😭 (laughing/crying-laughing), sparingly rather than every message
teasing, dry, understated tone rather than enthusiastic/exclamation-heavy
notes: Style extracted from actual chat patterns (word length, punctuation habits, common words) — not the conversation content itself, since that shouldn't be baked into a file the AI reads verbatim. Adjust freely. Never commit self.json — it's in .gitignore.
